module: Flowgraph node "Drift Race Path" (category repeat_instant, drift). Uses a race path (racePath pin) to define checkpoints, destination and start position via gameplay_drift_destination.setRacePath. Additional input pin: disableWrongWayAndDist (disables the wrong-way and remaining-distance messages). Outputs: pathData (path data for other nodes) and waypoints (table).
notes: Path resolved with mgr:getRelativeAbsolutePath; outputs unchanged if it is invalid.
Calls setRacePath again every frame as long as the node is reached.

work.desc: Calls setRacePath({filePath, disableWrongWayAndDist}) then reads getWaypoints() and getPathData(file).
